Title: About Page - Page Load and Display
Steps:
1. Navigate to https://testifysolutions.net/about/
2. Wait for page to fully load
3. Verify page title
4. Check main content
Expected Result:
- Page loads within 3 seconds
- Page title contains 'About' or 'About Us'
- Header and footer visible
- Main content section loaded
- No 404 errors

Title: About Page - Company Mission Statement
Steps:
1. Locate mission/vision statement
2. Verify heading and content
3. Check for clarity and completeness
Expected Result:
- Mission statement clearly stated
- Text is readable and well-formatted
- No lorem ipsum or placeholder text
- Statement aligns with homepage value prop
- Content is inspiring and professional

Title: About Page - Company History Section
Steps:
1. Scroll to company history/timeline section
2. Verify content is present
3. Check for key milestones
Expected Result:
- History section present (if applicable)
- Timeline or narrative format
- Key dates mentioned: founding, major achievements
- Content is factual and professional
- Images or graphics support narrative (if present)

Title: About Page - Team Section Display
Steps:
1. Scroll to team members section
2. Count number of team members displayed
3. Verify information for each member
Expected Result:
- Team section heading: 'Our Team', 'Meet the Team', etc.
- Each member has: Photo, Name, Role/Title
- Photos are professional quality
- Names and titles are accurate
- Layout is clean (grid or list format)

Title: About Page - Team Member Photos
Steps:
1. Verify all team member photos load
2. Check image quality and aspect ratio
3. Verify consistent styling
Expected Result:
- All photos load successfully (no broken images)
- Photos are uniform size/shape
- Professional quality images
- Consistent aspect ratio (e.g., all square or all portrait)
- Alt text present for accessibility

Title: About Page - Team Member Bio/Details
Steps:
1. Click on team member card (if interactive)
2. Verify bio or details appear
3. Check for social links (LinkedIn, etc.)
Expected Result:
- If clickable: Modal or expanded view appears
- Bio text is informative
- Social media links present (LinkedIn most common)
- Links open in new tab
- Close/back button functional

Title: About Page - Values Section
Steps:
1. Locate company values section
2. Verify all values are listed
3. Check descriptions
Expected Result:
- Values section present (e.g., 'Our Values', 'What We Stand For')
- Typically 3-6 core values listed
- Each value has clear description
- Icons or graphics support values (optional)
- Content is genuine and not generic

Title: About Page - Services Overview
Steps:
1. Locate services or offerings section
2. Verify services are listed
3. Check for consistency with other pages
Expected Result:
- Services mentioned align with homepage
- Key services: On-demand QA, Testing Framework, Marketplace
- Brief descriptions provided
- Links to detailed service pages (if applicable)
- No contradictions with other page content

Title: About Page - Call-to-Action Buttons
Steps:
1. Identify all CTA buttons on page
2. Verify button text and styling
3. Click each CTA
4. Verify destinations
Expected Result:
- Common CTAs: 'Contact Us', 'Get Started', 'Learn More'
- Buttons are visually prominent
- Hover states work
- CTAs redirect correctly:
  - Contact Us → /contact/
  - Get Started → /marketplace/ or /contact/
  - Learn More → relevant service page

Title: About Page - Social Proof Elements
Steps:
1. Look for testimonials section
2. Check for client logos or case studies
3. Verify statistics or achievements
Expected Result:
- Testimonials present with: Quote, Name, Company, Photo (optional)
- Client/partner logos displayed (if any)
- Statistics: '1,000+ Successful Deployments', etc.
- Awards or certifications (if applicable)
- Content is credible and specific

Title: About Page - Company Culture Section
Steps:
1. Look for culture or workplace section
2. Check for photos or descriptions
3. Verify authenticity
Expected Result:
- Culture section present (optional)
- Office photos or team photos
- Description of work environment
- Benefits or perks mentioned (if recruiting)
- Content feels authentic (not stock photos)

Title: About Page - Locations/Contact Info
Steps:
1. Locate contact information
2. Verify address (if physical location)
3. Check for map or directions
Expected Result:
- Email address visible
- Physical address (if applicable)
- Embedded Google Maps (optional)
- Phone number (if provided)
- Link to full contact page

Title: About Page - Responsive Design Mobile
Steps:
1. Load about page on mobile
2. Scroll through entire page
3. Verify layout adapts
4. Test interactions
Expected Result:
- Content stacks vertically
- Team member cards resize or stack
- Images scale appropriately
- Text remains readable (font size adequate)
- No horizontal scrolling
- Buttons remain tappable

Title: About Page - Responsive Design Tablet
Steps:
1. Load about page on tablet
2. Verify layout
3. Test landscape and portrait
Expected Result:
- Layout uses available space well
- 2-column layouts where appropriate
- Images and text balanced
- Navigation works smoothly
- Portrait and landscape both functional

Title: About Page - Content Readability
Steps:
1. Check text size and font
2. Verify line height and spacing
3. Check color contrast
4. Test with browser zoom at 200%
Expected Result:
- Font size minimum 16px (or scalable)
- Line height 1.5 or greater
- Color contrast ratio meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text)
- Page remains usable at 200% zoom
- No text truncation at zoom levels

Title: About Page - Heading Structure
Steps:
1. Inspect heading tags (H1, H2, H3, etc.)
2. Verify hierarchy is logical
3. Use screen reader to navigate by headings
Expected Result:
- Single H1: Page title ('About Us')
- H2 for main sections: Team, Mission, Values, etc.
- H3 for subsections
- No skipped heading levels (H1 → H3 without H2)
- Screen reader can navigate by headings

Title: About Page - Image Alt Text
Steps:
1. Inspect all images
2. Verify alt attributes are present
3. Check quality of alt text
Expected Result:
- All images have alt attributes
- Decorative images: alt='' (empty)
- Meaningful images: descriptive alt text
- Team photos: 'Photo of [Name], [Role]'
- No 'image.jpg' or generic alt text

Title: About Page - Link Text Clarity
Steps:
1. Review all link text on page
2. Verify links are descriptive
3. Check for 'click here' or 'read more' without context
Expected Result:
- No vague link text like 'click here' or 'read more'
- Links are descriptive: 'Learn about our testing services'
- Link purpose clear from text alone
- External links indicated (icon or text)
- Links have :focus styles

Title: About Page - Video Content (if present)
Preconditions:
- About page loaded
- Video section visible
Steps:
1. Locate company video or demo
2. Verify video player loads
3. Play video
4. Test controls
Expected Result:
- Video player loads (YouTube, Vimeo, or native)
- Play button functional
- Video plays without buffering (on normal connection)
- Controls visible: play/pause, volume, fullscreen
- Captions available (for accessibility)
- Video is relevant and professional

Title: About Page - Load Performance
Steps:
1. Open DevTools
2. Navigate to about page
3. Measure load time and LCP
4. Check for large images
Expected Result:
- Page loads in under 3 seconds
- LCP under 2.5 seconds
- Images are optimized (compressed)
- No render-blocking resources
- Lazy loading for below-fold images

Title: About Page - Content Accuracy
Preconditions:
- About page loaded
- Access to source documentation
Steps:
1. Read all content on about page
2. Verify against company documentation
3. Check for outdated information
4. Verify team member accuracy
Expected Result:
- All information is accurate and current
- Team members are current employees
- No outdated achievements or stats
- Company name and branding consistent
- No typos or grammatical errors

Title: About Page - SEO Metadata
Steps:
1. Inspect page source
2. Verify meta tags
3. Check Open Graph tags
Expected Result:
- Title tag: 'About Us - Testify Labs' or similar
- Meta description present and compelling (150-160 chars)
- Relevant keywords included naturally
- Open Graph tags for social sharing:
  - og:title
  - og:description
  - og:image
- Canonical URL set

Title: About Page - Navigation Breadcrumbs
Steps:
1. Look for breadcrumb navigation
2. Verify breadcrumb trail
3. Test breadcrumb links
Expected Result:
- Breadcrumbs present: Home > About
- Breadcrumbs styled clearly
- Links work: Home links to homepage
- Current page (About) not linked or styled differently
- Structured data for breadcrumbs (optional)
